title: Are You Willing To Open The Door
firstLine: Are you willing to open the door

lines: Are you willing to open the door
Are you willing to walk in His way
And leave the paths of sin?
Are you willing to open the door
Are you willing to trust Him just now?
Are you willing to open the door
Are you willing to bid Him come in
And give to him your all?
He can take your guilt away,
Lost in sin, why longer stray?
